subject: StratifyAI onboarding: model sieve & token matrix
thread_messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma@stratify.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: model shortlist + token profile for StratifyAI onboarding

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We agreed to send over our basic workload profile so you can recommend a short list of models and a token-budget plan. Attached is a quick CSV export of our example prompts and a small sample of user messages. Can you and your implementation team take a look and propose: 1) a shortlist of 2–3 candidate models, 2) an expected context-length profile we should provision for, and 3) a ballpark monthly token estimate for our projected traffic?

Quick context: StratifyAI will use Redwood to power in-product insights for analyst queries. Expected traffic ramp: start at ~1k daily active users (DAU) generating ~9k prompts/day, average response length about 180 tokens, and 95th percentile prompt size 600 tokens. We expect to ramp to 10k DAU over 6 months.

Attaching: token-profile-stratify.xlsx. Happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Thanks,
Emma Clarke
Director of Data Products
StratifyAI

---

On Mon, 3 Aug 2026 at 10:45, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@stratify.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: model shortlist + token profile for StratifyAI onboarding

Emma —

Got the spreadsheet, thanks. Quick read of the numbers suggests we should treat this as a mixed-latency workload: many short lookups (<=200 tokens) plus a long-tail of few-shot/follow-up sessions that hit the 600 token mark. For a staged onboarding we recommend:

- Phase A (MVP): prioritize cost predictability and throughput — propose 1) Mistral-Instruct-7B (quantized), 2) Llama-3-13B (8-bit) as the primary candidates.
- Phase B (quality guardrails): add Falcon-40B or equivalent for higher-quality, longer-context sessions that we route only for specific flows (summarization, multi-turn synthesis).

High-level sizing notes we need from you to finalize numbers:
1) % of queries that include long user context/history (are follow-ups common?).
2) Target P95 latency SLO for interactive analyst flows (we usually see sub-800ms for small models at 8–16 token/sec server-side; larger models will be higher).
3) Any regulatory requirements on private deployments (e.g., need for Dedicated or Private).

Priyom/Monica — can you take the sheet and draft a token-volume estimate and concurrency plan for the 1k->10k DAU ramp? Put calc assumptions in the spreadsheet so Emma can review. I will propose a short rollout plan after we have those numbers.

— Rishi

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Emma Clarke <emma@stratify.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: model shortlist + token profile for StratifyAI onboarding

Thanks Emma — I pulled the token-profile-stratify.xlsx into a working sheet and sketched the following assumptions and outputs. See attached model-eval-notes.pdf for quick rationale per-candidate.

Assumptions (from Emma's note + sample sheet):- Launch DAU: 1,000; queries/day per DAU: 9 -> 9,000 queries/day- Average prompt tokens: 120 (prompt only), average response tokens: 180 -> average round-trip 300 tokens- 12% of queries include long history/few-shot context bumping to 600 token prompts- Ramp plan to 10k DAU uniformly over 26 weeks- Peak concurrency target (95th percentile): 75 concurrent requests at launch, 750 at full ramp (accounting for burst and retry behavior)

Per-month token estimate (launch):
- Daily tokens: 9,000 queries * 300 tokens = 2.7M tokens/day -> ~81M tokens/month
- With 12% long-history bump averaged in, effective tokens/month ~= 93M tokens

Model candidate sizing (recommended instance types and quantization):
- Mistral-Instruct-7B (q4_0): best cost/latency for short flows. Estimated cost per 1M tokens: low. Can serve 180–220 QPS on a 4-GPU shard with batching depending on sequence lengths.
- Llama-3-13B (8-bit): balanced quality and cost; better multi-turn coherence. Expect higher GPU memory and slightly higher latency — good for mid-tier flows.
- Falcon-40B (fp16 / 4-bit pilots): reserve for heavy-lift or extractive summarization flows; route 5–10% of traffic to this model to contain cost.

Recommendations / action items for the onboarding checklist:
1) Rishi/Monica: confirm P95 latency SLO (300–800ms range).
2) Emma: share real distribution of prompt lengths if available (histogram helps refine batching).
3) Monica: create a mutual-action-plan.docx with milestones for Phase A/B and SLA gates.
4) Engineering: enable prefix caching for repeated prompts (we estimate ~8% token savings on repeated analytic templates).

I attached model-eval-notes.pdf with perf runs and reasoned tradeoffs. If everyone is aligned I can produce the monthly token breakout across the ramp with per-model allocations.

— Priyom

Attachment: model-eval-notes.pdf (summary of perf runs and memory footprints)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@stratify.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: model shortlist + token profile for StratifyAI onboarding

Emma / team —

I've drafted the mutual-action-plan.docx and included a simple timeline:
- Week 0–1: Confirm token distribution and P95 SLO (owner: Emma + Rishi)
- Week 2: Model shortlist locked + perf smoke tests on sample traffic (owner: Priyom)
- Week 3–6: Phase A deployment (Mistral-Instruct + routing) + monitoring dashboard (owner: Monica)
- Week 6–12: Phase B canary for Falcon-40B flows and pilot routing for long-context jobs

A few clarifying notes:
- For budgeting, the immediate ask is the 'effective tokens / month' number that Priyom estimated (~93M). We'll map that to pricing tiers and recommended Reserved capacity if you prefer cost predictability.
- For the P95 SLO, from a product POV sub-600ms is desirable for in-product interactions; if you can accept up to 1.2s for heavy summarization that gives us room to route those to the larger model.

Propose a 30-minute technical handoff on Friday 7 Aug 2026 at 11:00 PT to walk through the token sheet and routing design. If that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite and attach the draft MAP.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

1) We'll confirm the prompt-length histogram by Thursday EOD.
2) For routing, we'd like a simple out-of-the-box rule: short flows -> small model, if user requests "full analysis" or attaches >5 documents, then route to Falcon-40B. Can Priyom show an example of a routing policy during the handoff?

Looking forward to the call and the MAP.

Best,
Emma

StratifyAI
